# Synthetic MUCOMSX regression corpus

Generated by `macos/tools/generate-msx-playback-fixtures.py` using the assembled
2026-10-13 toolchain after the RhythmMute repair. The twenty `.mub` files are real compiler outputs. Matching `.muc`
sources and a synthetic `voice.dat` allow independent source-playback tests.
No commercial song or copyrighted sample recordings are used.

`mapper-vectors.json` contains expected ordered output from the actual Z80 driver,
not from the C# implementation under test. See `macos/docs/MSX-PLAYBACK.md`.

The five raw v2 fixtures cover PSG, SCC, independent SCC+ channel 5,
clock-scaled SSG and mixed chip use. All fixtures include finite mute tails.

`tick-vectors.json` holds all 256 Timer-B periods obtained by executing the
shipped MUCPLAY `App_ComputeTickThreshold` routine, plus its COM hash.

The additional fixtures cover raw drum triggers alongside an unselected G-page
rest stream, and default-tempo native PSG / SCC SSG playback. The test project
copies the same six player-owned rhythm WAVs as the GUI, so rhythm-only audio
does not accidentally test an empty sample directory.

`rhythm-mute` preserves FM melody and masks only authored rhythm notes;
`rhythm-mute-raw` confirms that direct `y16` register writes retain their
values. The suite also exercises all 64 mute masks through source compilation,
including key-off safety. Provenance pins the repaired Work compiler/player.
